title: ci_workflow_perf: import Path only on unix so Windows clippy passes
goal: After the GitHub Actions removal (T-CLAUDERMGHA-1) every remaining use of std::path::Path in xtask/tests/ci_workflow_perf.rs is inside #[cfg(unix)] helpers, so `cargo clippy -D warnings` on x86_64-pc-windows-msvc fails with unused import `Path` (reported by the CEO's Windows pre-push hook). Gate the import on unix.
